title: A new benchmark for long-horizon agentic AI reasoning
tldr: A new evaluation framework measures agents on planning, tool use, and recovery — and finds frontier models still degrade on long tasks.

title: Open-source retrieval stacks narrow the gap on enterprise RAG
tldr: Hybrid sparse-plus-dense retrieval and graph stores are closing the quality gap with proprietary RAG pipelines.

title: Myanmar's digital economy: connectivity grows while governance lags
tldr: Mobile-first finance and connectivity expand across Myanmar, but unclear data-governance rules cap foreign technology partnerships.

title: ‘One Rohingya from every household’: Myanmar junta formalises forced conscription in Rakhine State
tldr: The Myanmar junta has formalised a policy of forced conscription in Rakhine State, requiring Rohingya communities to provide recruits on a rotating basis. This move has already forced thousands of Rohingya into service, according to residents. The policy is part of the junta's efforts to consolidate power and suppress the Rohingya minority.

title: Escalation of Aerial Warfare in Rakhine: Junta Airstrikes Target Civilian Populations Amidst Arakan Army Gains
tldr: A Myanmar military airstrike in Thandwe Township, Rakhine State, killed 14 civilians, including 11 females, as the junta increasingly relies on airpower to counter Arakan Army (AA) territorial gains. The strikes highlight a strategic shift toward targeting non-combatant areas as ground forces face significant losses.
